name: erp_customer_payment_create
description: Record a customer payment and apply it to an open invoice; reduces the invoice's amount remaining and marks it paid when it reaches zero. Overpayments, voided invoices and currency mismatches are rejected (POST /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment)

applied_to.description: Invoice tranId to apply the payment against, e.g. INV-1004.

payment.description: Payment amount to apply (payment); must not exceed the invoice's amount remaining.

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id; defaults to the invoice's customer.

trandate.description: Payment date (trandate), YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.

payment_method.description: Payment method: wire, ach, check or card (default wire).

currency.description: Payment currency internal id; must match the invoice currency (defaults to it).
